jobs.title: Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description: Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared! In a nutshell  As a Product Manager at Picnic, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation , tackling complex challenges with fresh, groundbreaking solutions. This role is all about driving impact - you’ll develop product strategies by analyzing data and identifying opportunities that push boundaries and define the way we’re building our supply chain logic. Tricks of the trade Setting new standards: implementing the next generation of purchasing algorithms, last mile logic, warehouse components or onboarding automation Improving the fully automated warehouse: going beyond the business case by designing better strategies and building robust systems (e.g. designing new picking strategies, improving the automated storage system) Innovating across borders: building a new fully automated warehouse in Germany, opening a new warehouse in France or working on a streamlined supply chain across borders? You will deliver impact all over Europe. Building sustainable solutions : launch new initiatives to improve the quality of fresh products like fruits, vegetables and bread during storage and delivery to improve customer satisfaction, and enable us to operate a supply chain where we consider safety first  Leading with ambition: Using your relentless determination and grit to take the driver's seat and redefine the puzzle behind a smooth grocery shopping experience Your superpowers Master’s degree in Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics or an equivalent quantitative study 2-5 years of work experience in a product-led company, ideally experienced with building supply chain solutions Problem-solving mindset and passion for tackling complex challenges Strong communication skills which allow you to convert abstract plans into concrete actions for your team *Please Note:  This is not a one-time hire. We’re hiring for this role throughout the year as part of our ongoing growth and expansion.   Picnic Perks  🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks  Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up. 🚲Health insurance discount & bike plan We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate 🗺️Relocation If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application.  🍎Learning & development  You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses.  ⛳All the rest  At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Graduate Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description: Always wanted to build the systems behind one of Europe's most advanced supply chains? As part of this Graduate Program, you'll own part of Picnic's supply chain tech products from day one. You'll be end-to-end responsible for developing products that power our operations by understanding operational challenges, analyzing data, working with business teams, designing solutions with engineers, and validating impact through experiments and analytics. You're the one making it happen. The program at Picnic is one of the most ambitious tracks in the industry: from recent graduate to Product Manager. Wondering what problems you’ll work on? Think optimising how items are picked in our automated fulfilment center, decreasing waste by optimal ordering, designing a flow how we make sure coolpacks for chilled deliveries get back to the fulfilment center or integrating with robots to automate our operations even more. What you'll be doing Over 18 months you'll learn everything it takes to build a great product by actually doing it. You'll work alongside experienced product managers in our team. You will spend your program embedded deeply in one supply chain domain to see the long-term impact of your products, with options to expand scope into adjacent domains as you scale after 18 months. Every 3 months, you will reflect on your growth and define new learning goals with your mentor to grow you into the Product Manager role as fast as possible.  0-6 months You learn how to solve operational and internal user problems. From day one, you’ll help build features used by thousands of users, while getting to know our product end to end. To understand what to build, you’ll analyze operational processes through data analysis and interviews. Based on your learnings you’ll help shape new features. 6-12 months You build your first features from scratch. This is the first time you'll own the full product development lifecycle. With the help of an experienced Product Manager, you’ll scope a supply chain problem, shape the solution across design, engineering, data, and business. You’ll drive execution on your plan, ship to customers & see the direct impact of your work. 12+ months You own a product scope end to end. You decide what problems to solve and own the solutions: the research, the analyses, the designs, the stakeholders, the tech. You are in the lead and responsible for the outcome. The Program The launchpad to Product Manager . Learn everything there is about building product & become a PM twice as fast as the industry standard. Ownership from day one . You’ll immediately work on improving our Supply Chain, alongside our experienced product teams. You’ll get to experience different scopes ranging from warehouse operations to ordering inbound and from optimal planning of deliveries and routing to our in-house built apps used by thousands of our operational colleagues.  Tangible impact : Every feature you ship is measured, so you'll see the exact impact of your decisions in real data. If it works, double down. If it doesn't, own it and iterate. Mentorship : You'll have a dedicated mentor accelerating your growth. Your mentor will grow you as a Product Manager, and also be your guide into the domain. But most of what you learn, you learn by actually doing it. Who are you We’re looking for future leaders who are hungry to learn, eager to build, and passionate about our mission. You don’t need years of product management experience, but you do need to show us you have the raw talent and drive to succeed. Master's degree in a quantitative field like Econometrics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. Recent graduate or up to two years of professional experience. Builder at heart. You've taken initiative and created something from scratch, whether that's a side project, a new idea, or your own startup. Highly ambitious, natural curiosity and empathy for users. You want to understand, you're always asking "why", and you always think about how to make things better. Go-getter personality. You're biased toward action and constantly pushing toward clarity and delivery. Many strong candidates talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this role excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. This vacancy remains open, we hire throughout the year whenever we find the right match. Why Picnic? Invent the future: We’re not just improving an industry; we’re rebuilding it from scratch. You'll work on challenges no one has solved before. Hands-on from day one: We believe in doing, not just theorizing. You'll get your hands dirty, build real things, and see your impact immediately. Learn by doing, together: We do, we fail, we learn. You'll work side-by-side with top-notch colleagues who will challenge and support you every day. A sustainable mission: Join a company committed to making the world a better place, one electric vehicle at a time. Have fun along the way: We celebrate our successes with legendary parties, team events, and free daily lunches. Ready to build the future with us? Apply now and tell us what you would build first. Picnic Perks  🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks  Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up. 🚲Health insurance discount & bike plan We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate 🗺️Relocation If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application.  🍎Learning & development  You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses.  ⛳All the rest  At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan.
